newsitem.title: GERMANY: Protesters attack German police during protest.
newsitem.headline: Protesters attack German police during protest.

text.p: Around 400 protesters threw bottles and stones at police during a march against right-wing extremism in the east German city of Magdeburg on Saturday.
Police said around 2,000 people took part in the protest, organised in response to the killing of a 17-year old punk rocker who was beaten and stabbed to death earlier this month.
An extreme right-winger has been arrested on suspicion of carrying out the attack.
The march began peacefully with a rally in the city centre but violence erupted after some of the protesters tried to move towards a club frequented by right-wingers.
The demonstrators attacked police blocking their route to the club. Police fought back with trucheons and made several arrests.
Punks had also clashed with police during an unofficial demonstration last week.
